executions.name: label_roles
executions.sql:
SELECT concept_class, address_role, COUNT(*) AS label_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.entity_labels_v1`
GROUP BY concept_class, address_role
ORDER BY concept_class, address_role

executions.name: daily_class_threshold_coverage
executions.sql:
SELECT DATE(block_timestamp) AS activity_date,
  to_concept_class AS concept_class, to_address_role AS address_role,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  COUNTIF(value_wei = 0) AS zero_value_count,
  COUNTIF(value_wei > 0) AS positive_value_count,
  COUNTIF(value_wei >= NUMERIC '10000000000000000') AS at_least_001_eth_count,
  COUNTIF(value_wei >= NUMERIC '100000000000000000') AS at_least_01_eth_count,
  COUNTIF(value_wei >= NUMERIC '1000000000000000000') AS at_least_1_eth_count,
  COUNTIF(value_wei >= NUMERIC '10000000000000000000') AS at_least_10_eth_count,
  COUNTIF(value_wei >= NUMERIC '1000000000000000000' AND receipt_status = 1)
    AS successful_at_least_1_eth_count,
  MAX(value_wei) AS maximum_value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`
  (DATE '2026-05-31', DATE '2026-07-01')
WHERE to_concept_class IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY activity_date, concept_class, address_role
ORDER BY concept_class, address_role, activity_date

executions.name: production_witness_BridgeProtocol
executions.sql:
SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, to_address, to_owner, to_concept_class, value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '2026-06-15', DATE '2026-06-16')
WHERE to_concept_class = 'BridgeProtocol' AND value_wei >= NUMERIC '1000000000000000000'
ORDER BY value_wei DESC
LIMIT 1
